entries.jp: {FB00}{v:007F}１体、１体は弱いが、数で迫られると不利になる。{n}{FB00}注意して戦うんだ！
entries.en: {FB00}{v:007F}They're weak on their own, but we'll be at a{n}disadvantage if they swarm us. {FB00}Fight carefully!

entries.jp: {v:0080}アタシ達のことはいいから、先に逃げて！
entries.en: {v:0080}Don't worry about us! Get out of here!

entries.jp: あとは、ここの怪物をやっつければ、{n}おっけーだね！
entries.en: Now we just beat the monsters here, and we're all set!

entries.jp: {v:0007}バカバカバカ！{n}なにやってんのよ！
entries.en: {v:0007}Idiot, idiot, idiot! What are you doing?!

entries.jp: {v:0082}もう残っている卵もないね。
entries.en: {v:0082}There aren't any eggs left now, either.
{v:0083}And the villagers made it out safe.

entries.jp: {v:0084}さ、もうここは大丈夫だって、{n}村長さんに教えてあげようよ。
entries.en: {v:0084}Come on, let's tell the village chief it's safe here now.
